description: Adaptive research pipeline where the planner LLM decides N sub-topics at runtime. Row-wise researcher writes one note per subtopic; synthesizer combines into a markdown brief. Where DynamicOutput / dynamic partitions fits — N is truly runtime-decided.

max_subtopics.description: Upper bound the planner is told about. The LLM picks up to this many at runtime.
max_subtopics.label: Max Subtopics

researcher_system_message.description: Optional override for the researcher's system prompt. Default is a generic 'be concise, cite plausible sources' persona.
researcher_system_message.label: Researcher System Message

brief_system_message.description: Optional override for the synthesizer's system prompt.
brief_system_message.label: Brief System Message

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog.
kinds.label: Kinds
